[{"id": "n21LGtr2Dm", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🛠️ Operations Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "us1PtEET1j", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Operations module helps you run the church buildings and the church office. Use it to book rooms and equipment, keep a list of what the church owns, give jobs and repairs to people, and keep the minutes of your meetings.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "rNdKHPzz6J", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church Managers add and change everything in this module. Church Staff can read rooms, assets, locations and published minutes, change tasks, and book rooms for themselves. Members ask for a room in the member portal.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "DvNhTjeIBJ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Operations workspace starts with the work that waits for you. Open Tasks shows how many tasks are not Completed. Booking Requests shows how many room bookings wait for a decision (Requested or Conflict) and opens them as a table. Tasks Board shows the open tasks as cards, in a column for each status.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "sv0Rvi-pWU", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Under them, the charts show the open tasks by priority and the approved and completed room bookings of each week. The sidebar lists Rooms, Room Bookings, Assets, Tasks and Meeting Minutes. The Reports folder holds Room Usage, Assets on Loan and Open Church Work Orders. Locations is in the Setup folder.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ptxHAW784b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "🚪Rooms", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0jK3aRaVjI", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Room is a space that people can book, such as the sanctuary, a classroom or the fellowship hall. Each room has its own booking rules: who approves its bookings, how it can be set up and what to ask the person who books it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "tBuk-JXiXH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
The fellowship hall holds 120 people. It can be set up as Banquet (tables for 64) or Theatre (rows of chairs). Bookings need approval from the facilities manager, and each booking must say how many guests will come and whether they need the sound system.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Pal1KdFmZ0", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Add a room", "col": 12}}, {"id": "S7fwR1GpTZ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Open Rooms and click Add Room.
2. Type the Room Name and pick its Location, such as the building it is in.
3. Fill in the Capacity, the number of people it holds.
4. Set the booking rules (see below) and save.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ZVicjk6etg", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A new room is Bookable. Untick Bookable for a room that people may not book, such as the church office. Bookings of a room that is not bookable are refused.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "CtLRTRgnsa", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Capacity does more than inform. When a Function books the room, check-in can stop at the room's capacity (see the Ministries manual). The Book a Room dialog on a Function shows the capacity of each room. Leave Capacity empty for no limit.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "g2NR8kL8L1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Each church gives its rooms their own names, so two churches can each have a room called Sanctuary. One church cannot have two rooms with the same name. The Bookings and Work Orders sections at the top of a room show its bookings and the work orders that name it. You cannot delete a room that a booking or a task names.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TvOY-oXUrA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Approval and approvers", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Hn0Qx5LXm1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "In the Booking Rules section:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "3l8FZEBo8K", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Requires Approval: tick it when someone must approve each booking. Without it, every booking is approved at once.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Lmp6DPPnAd", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Approvers: the users who approve the bookings of this room. Each approver needs the Church Staff or Church Manager role and access to the church of the room. When the table is empty, the Church Managers of the church approve.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "uG9naJvCvo", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Setups", "col": 12}}, {"id": "hyDGO0X6Je", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Add the ways that a room can be set up, such as Banquet or Theatre, in the Setups table. Give each setup a name that the room does not use yet, and add the capacity, a description and a photo if you want. A booking can then choose one of these setups (see Room Bookings). If you remove a setup from a room, the bookings that already use it keep it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "pgcoICPfRi", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Questions", "col": 12}}, {"id": "H7TiUW_OoF", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To ask each booking of a room some questions, such as the number of guests or the need for sound, choose a Question Set in Question Set (see the Ministries manual for Question Sets). A room can use a Question Set of your church or a shared one.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-lOVGa8ccA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When someone chooses the room on a booking, the questions open in a dialog. Click Done to keep the answers. To change them later, click Answer Questions. A booking cannot be saved until each required question has an answer.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OoFCs_Bkzi", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- If you move a booking to a room with other questions, the old answers are removed and you answer the new questions.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "G0hrMh68gI", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- If you change the Question Set of a room, its bookings keep their old answers until someone answers again with Answer Questions.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "wI27lujyEL", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Members cannot book a room that has a required question in the member portal, and the Book a Room button on a Function does not offer a room with a Question Set. Book these rooms on the Room Booking form.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "wa5IIvluNF", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "📅Room Bookings", "col": 12}}, {"id": "RU9D0k2h12", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Room Booking reserves a room, equipment or both for a time. Churchit makes sure that two bookings never hold the same room or the same equipment at the same time.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "e5A-EslWca", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Click Room Bookings in the sidebar to open the calendar of bookings by month, week or day. Click a booking to open it. The calendar does not show Denied and Cancelled bookings: remove the Status filter to see them. To see the bookings as a list, click Calendar View at the top and choose List View. To find a booking by its number, such as BK-0012 on a setup sheet, type it in the ID box of the list.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "F-AUAGMlQz", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Book a room", "col": 12}}, {"id": "S9fgv1xc_L", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Open Room Bookings and click Add Room Booking. Your own name is filled in as the Requester. The Requester must be a person of the church that books the room.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Tof4IRbDqN", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "2. Fill in the Purpose, then choose the Room. Only bookable rooms are offered. Answer the room's questions if a dialog opens.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "PAOBD3oxZe", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "3. Fill in the Start and the End. The Purpose shows on the calendar.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "LmcpXVZw6p", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "4. To ask for a setup, open the Setup section, choose one of the room's setups and add Setup Notes for the people who set up the room.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "2m5prkt_R6", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "5. Save.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Tw_GhrqLXU", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church Staff can read all bookings of their church, and add and change their own. Church Managers can change every booking.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Dyf_FulnYq", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Approval", "col": 12}}, {"id": "xfaC3q_jkE", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "On a room that does not require approval, a new booking is Approved at once. On a room with Requires Approval ticked, a new booking is Requested until an approver decides. A booking that an approver of the room makes is approved at once.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "UqP2KMjI3c", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Each approver gets a To Do for each Requested booking, with the room, the purpose and the time. The approver opens the booking and clicks Actions, then Approve or Deny. The To Dos close, and the person who made the booking gets an email with the decision and a link to the booking. When staff book a room for someone else, the staff member gets this email, not the Requester.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "B19vqzwEPJ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "If someone who is not an approver changes the room, the start or the end of an approved booking, it goes back to Requested and waits for approval again. A change to the notes keeps it approved.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "iE1kG6mwhH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Other statuses: Cancelled frees the room, and anyone who may change the booking can set it. Completed marks a booking that is over. A Denied booking can be opened again only by an approver.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "qqRmiF89s0", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When two bookings clash", "col": 12}}, {"id": "rocRdBXaWA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Two bookings of one room cannot overlap. When a new booking clashes, Churchit refuses it and names the bookings in the way, with their purpose and time. It counts the bookings of other churches but does not name them.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "uWcqLUyLNH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "If you still need the room, tick Request Anyway in the If the Room Is Taken section and save. The booking gets the status Conflict, and each approver gets a To Do. A Conflict booking does not stop other people from booking the room. The approver opens it and clicks Actions, then one of these:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ekhXTyHE_W", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Keep This Booking approves it and denies the Requested and Conflict bookings that it clashes with. It shows only when no Approved or Blocked booking holds the room at that time.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "a7JWRqvv5o", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Share the Room ticks Can Share Room on it and on each booking that it clashes with, and approves it. Two bookings that both have Can Share Room ticked do not clash.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "xxBj5wPiDb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Deny denies it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "8-kUCS0Swa", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
The youth group's booking of the fellowship hall on Tuesday at 7 PM is Approved. The women's Bible study then needs the same hall at the same time, so its leader ticks Request Anyway. The pastor opens the Conflict booking. The hall is big enough for both groups, so the pastor clicks Share the Room: the Bible study's booking is approved, and both groups use the hall. If the youth booking were still Requested, the pastor would approve it too.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "yLVAAaISib", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Block a room", "col": 12}}, {"id": "O0dbIm75Bs", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To keep a room free, for example for repairs or a holiday, an approver of the room adds a Room Booking with the status Blocked. It needs no Requester. When the room has no Approvers, a Church Manager blocks it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "EkndcVlpd5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- When you save a blocked time, each Requested or Conflict booking at that time is denied.
- An Approved booking at that time stops the block from saving. Cancel or move that booking first.
- Nobody can book a blocked time, also not with Request Anyway.
- Only an approver of the room (or a Church Manager when the room has no approvers) can change or remove a blocked time.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "COhtLd2ah6", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
The sanctuary floor is refinished in the first week of March. The facilities manager blocks the sanctuary for that week. Two requests for that week are denied at once, and nobody can ask for it again until the block ends.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "J4v4kntCF3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Book equipment", "col": 12}}, {"id": "NOrA45Av2-", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To book a Church Asset, such as a projector or the church van, first tick Bookable on the asset. Then choose it in Equipment on a Room Booking. Leave Room empty to book only equipment. A booking of equipment only is approved at once and belongs to your church.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "bVU42N9OfW", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Equipment can be in only one booking at a time, and a Conflict booking holds its equipment too. If another booking has the equipment at that time, Churchit refuses the booking and names the other one.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "1H1CERD5yO", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Lend equipment", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Nk-xvY51Ue", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Use a Room Booking with only equipment to lend something to a person.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0TRVhNijuX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Add a Room Booking, choose the equipment in Equipment and leave Room empty.
2. When the borrower takes the equipment, open the booking and click Actions, then Check Out. Checked Out On shows the time.
3. When the borrower brings it back, click Actions, then Check In. Returned On shows the time, and the status changes to Completed.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "b7z1Y9_0ic", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Only Church Manager and System Manager users can check equipment out or in, and nobody can type these times by hand. You cannot check out equipment that is still out on another booking: check in that booking first. A Completed booking does not hold its room or its equipment.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "4EbD07saKX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Assets on Loan report shows all equipment that is out and not returned. The booking with the oldest End is at the top, so late returns show first.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Eswpc-yZj4", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
Deacon Smith borrows the projector for a weekend retreat. The office books the projector from Friday to Monday with no room and clicks Check Out when he picks it up. On Tuesday the projector is still not back, so it is at the top of Assets on Loan. When he returns it, the office clicks Check In.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "G95Y5N0Cw_", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Rooms for a Function", "col": 12}}, {"id": "zViFeQFWz0", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To book rooms for a Function, open the Function and click Actions, then Book a Room. Choose one or more rooms and any equipment, check the Requester and the times, and click Book. Each room gets its own booking, and the equipment goes with the first booking that saves.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "btzDGLbZFl", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- When a Function is deleted, its bookings are deleted too.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "gJvk5Cfm0L", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- A recurring Function copies the Requested and Approved bookings of its first Function to each new one. A copy that clashes becomes a Conflict. A copy that cannot be saved, for example in a blocked time, is skipped, and a comment on the new Function says so.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "06Pws9Tb1V", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The public church calendar shows the rooms of a Function's approved bookings.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Z4gTQkdJYn", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Room requests from members", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ZoJg-OplO9", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Members ask for a room on the Book a Room page of the member portal (it opens at /portal/room-request). A member clicks Ask for a room, chooses a room, the start and the end, says what it is for, and can add notes.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "GKonRzqZyH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The page offers only the bookable rooms of the member's church and the shared rooms, and not a room with a required question.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "eb2srqsCDM", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The member is always the Requester. A member can ask only for a time that has not passed, and for one day at most. For a longer booking, the member asks the church office.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "qsZfVOwUE2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Members cannot book equipment, and a request that clashes is refused. Staff add equipment to the booking if needed.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "beEMCba9Ho", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- On a room that requires approval, the request stays Requested until an approver decides, and the member gets an email with the decision.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "75JmGnAmVn", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The page lists the member's own requests with the room, the time and the status. A booking that staff made for the member does not show there. A member can change a request that is still to come, unless it was denied, cancelled or completed. Only staff can cancel it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "_IYzqoK6IG", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "If your portal menu does not have Book a Room, open Portal Settings and add a row to Menu with the Title Book a Room, the Route room-request, the Reference Document Type Room Booking and the Role Church User.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "i9OZRJUCqP", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Setup sheets", "col": 12}}, {"id": "6lPUCt9zh9", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To give the people who set up a room what they need, open the Room Booking, click Print and choose Setup Sheet. The sheet shows the room, the times, the purpose and the requester, the setup with its capacity and description, the setup notes, the equipment and the answers to the room's questions. Print it or click Get PDF.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "1HREpYA0uZ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Reports", "col": 12}}, {"id": "lcWCE8uA8g", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Room Usage (in the Reports folder) shows how your rooms and equipment are used: one row for each booking in the dates you choose, with the hours. It opens on the current month and lists every status, also Denied and Cancelled, until you choose a Status. You can also filter by Room. Church Managers and Church Staff can open it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Pwx7UCRCbA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Booking Requests (the shortcut on the workspace) lists the Requested and Conflict bookings, the soonest first.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "xSgvNhrhhY", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Assets on Loan is described under Lend equipment.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "gJ6Pg4sUa0", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Rooms with more than one church", "col": 12}}, {"id": "mrUY86XkyE", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A room belongs to one church, and only that church can book it. Tick Shared with All Churches on a room to let every church book it. A shared room has one calendar for every church: every church sees its bookings, and a booking blocks that time for all of them. The name of a shared room must differ from every other room. You see the bookings of your churches and of the shared rooms.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "VZQ4-Zg5Dy", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "📦Assets", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ucHelZDZBn", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Church Asset is something the church owns and wants to keep track of, such as a projector, a piano, a van or a set of folding tables. Church Managers add and change assets. Church Staff can read them.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "aAvn52Xo4X", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To add an asset, open Assets, click Add Church Asset, give it a short title that people will recognize, such as Epson projector (fellowship hall), and choose its Location. Add the Acquisition Date, a photo in Image, and details such as the serial number or the purchase price in Notes.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "4b9CzMSaf1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Tick Bookable to let people book or borrow the asset (see Book equipment and Lend equipment under Room Bookings). To see only bookable assets, tick Bookable at the top of the list.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ErIjndWzYI", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The Bookings section at the top of an asset shows the bookings and loans that hold it. Work Orders shows the repairs that name it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "YIirYqki3L", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- You cannot delete an asset that a booking or a task names.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0vLnTJmx0b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "✅Tasks", "col": 12}}, {"id": "y8Dv5v1ZS3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Church Task is a job that someone must do, such as Order communion cups or Fix the leak in the kitchen. Give it a due date and a priority, assign it to a person, and Churchit reminds them before it is due.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "rq6F2k1i0w", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church Managers add tasks. Church Staff can change tasks, for example to move them to In Progress or Completed, but cannot add them.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "_ZDLSXTMQA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Add and assign a task", "col": 12}}, {"id": "EbVUpZkHHy", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Open Tasks and click Add Church Task.
2. Type the Title, and set the Due Date and the Priority (Low, Medium, High or Urgent).
3. Save.
4. To give the task to a person, click Assign in the sidebar of the task and choose the user.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "6eM2IhpGaw", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When you assign an Open task, its status changes to Assigned, and the person gets a notice. The assignment takes the title, the due date and the priority of the task, and follows them when you change them. You can assign only users who can see the church of the task. Church Staff can assign tasks, because they can change them. An Urgent task shows as High priority on the To Do. On the task list, My Tasks shows the tasks assigned to you.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "HnPiIzYN3u", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The day before a task is due, each person assigned to it gets an email and a desk notification, unless the task is Completed. A task that nobody is assigned to sends no reminder. To change the message or the number of days, a System Manager opens the Church Task Due notification.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "4mq5_g7k9R", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When you set the status to Completed, all assignments of the task close.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "LBw-xUsjbC", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
The pastor adds the task Order communion cups, due next Friday, and assigns it to Tom. The task changes to Assigned and Tom gets a notice. On Thursday Tom gets a reminder email. He orders the cups and sets the task to Completed, which closes his To Do.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t3_iIiarrk", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Bigger jobs", "col": 12}}, {"id": "mL81o4exDk", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Sub-tasks: tick Is Group on the main task, then make new tasks and choose the main task in Parent Task.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "UFcHhY_PXG", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Linked Records: to link the records that a task is about, such as a Person, a Room or a Function, add rows in Linked Records with an Item Type and an Item. Tick Done on a row when that part is finished.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "3rvxGUd93_", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
The task Prepare the church picnic has linked rows for the picnic Function, the Pavilion room and Karen, who brings the grill. When Karen confirms, you tick Done on her row.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "sEAJXAlDeO", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Tasks Board", "col": 12}}, {"id": "xTGUpVuFIl", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Tasks Board shows the open tasks as cards, in a column for each status: Open, Assigned and In Progress. Drag a card to another column to change its status. To complete a task, set its status to Completed on its form. Open the board from the workspace, or choose Kanban in the view menu at the top of the task list.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "DqN1XcavwG", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Work orders", "col": 12}}, {"id": "f2CQ86Z5vc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A work order is a task for a repair or a job on an asset or a room. Set Type to Work Order. The Work Order section then shows Requested By (the person who asked), Asset and Room. The asset, the room and the person must belong to the church of the task, or be shared with all churches.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "bKZmMyebv_", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Open Work Orders report (in the Reports folder) lists the work orders that are not Completed, the earliest due date first. The Work Orders section on an asset or a room shows how many work orders name it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "jFO1NNUHMy", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
An usher finds a leak over the choir loft. The office adds a task Fix the roof leak, with Type Work Order, Room Sanctuary, Requested By the usher and Priority High, and assigns it to the maintenance volunteer. It stays on Open Work Orders until it is Completed.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "vXC7sx92O5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "📝Meeting Minutes", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OeJxsdUsA1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Meeting Minutes keep the record of a board, elder or committee meeting: who was there, what was decided and, if you want, the recording.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "2m2mwRt5-e", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Open Meeting Minutes and click Add Meeting Minutes. You are filled in as Recorded By when your user has a Person record.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "hJn3l5H0qN", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "2. Type a Title, such as Elders meeting, and fill in the Meeting Date. If the meeting was a Function, choose it: the people who attended the Function are added to Attendees.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "_yubnw1xCp", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "3. Write the minutes in Minutes on the Details tab, and list who was present on the Attendees tab. A person can be on only one row.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "VYGnOAGs9L", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "4. If the meeting was recorded, attach the audio file in the Recording section. You can play it from the form. Only audio files are accepted.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fxq-z1UWgS", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Status and who can read the minutes", "col": 12}}, {"id": "WudmObe-ND", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Minutes move through Draft, Reviewed, Approved and Published. Only Church Managers can read minutes that are Draft, Reviewed or Approved. Church Staff can read them only when they are Published.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0KrHF5BfJp", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When you set the status to Approved or Published, Approved On gets today's date if it is empty. You can change the date, but it cannot be before the Meeting Date.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "IGsGkdYK5C", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
The secretary writes the elders' minutes as Draft and sets them to Reviewed after the chairman reads them. At the next meeting the elders approve them, and the secretary sets Approved.
